name: HIAS
story: Every **{international: cost_total / people_reached|$}** helps one displaced person abroad with legal protection, mental health care and cash, and every **{us-services: cost_total / people_reached|$}** helps one refugee in the US.
summary: A Jewish humanitarian organisation founded in 1881 in New York, based in Silver Spring, Maryland, that serves refugees and asylum seekers. In the US it was one of the ten national refugee resettlement agencies, working through about 30 local partners (mostly Jewish family services), and runs immigration legal services with pro bono lawyers, advocacy and litigation (a plaintiff in Pacito v. Trump against the 2025 suspension of refugee admissions). Abroad it runs legal protection, mental-health support, violence prevention, cash assistance and economic inclusion in about 15 countries, the largest in eastern Chad for Sudanese refugees and across Latin America. Federal funding was cut in January 2025. Modelled on the audited consolidated accounts for the year to 30 September 2025.
